gates.notes: Exit 0. 6 static routes exported (/, /add, /scan, /import-export, /_sitemap, /+not-found) plus a 1.43 MB web bundle. CORRECTION - the prior record claimed BUILD-001 web "passed" for this exact command, but it FAILED on current inputs: "Metro error: o.stringify is not a function" / "Failed to statically export route: +not-found", exit 1, empty dist/. Root cause: package.json pinned query-string ^9.5.1, which is ESM-only ("type":"module"), while expo-router 4.0.22 does require("query-string") as an UNDECLARED (phantom) dependency and nothing else in the tree declares it (verified: npm ls query-string --all shows only our own root). Pinned to ^7.1.3 (CommonJS, exposes .stringify); export then succeeded. Guarded by 2 new tests in __tests__/deps.test.ts, proven non-vacuous by re-installing 9.5.1 with --no-save and observing both fail.
